summary: Plugin that adds multi-agent orchestration to Claude Code, with autopilot, team and planning commands.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: oh-my-claudecode (OMC) adds multi-agent orchestration to Claude Code. It gives you commands like /autopilot to build a whole task, /team to run several agents in parallel, and planning and interview modes, so you can get more done without learning Claude Code's details.
sixtySeconds.problem: Coordinating several agents and long tasks in Claude Code takes setup and know-how. OMC packages workflows and agents so you can start with one command.
whoFor: Claude Code users wanting multi-agent workflows
Teams using several AI coding tools together
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a popular, MIT-licensed orchestration layer for Claude Code. A sister project, oh-my-codex, does the same for Codex CLI.
requirements: Node.js for the optional npm CLI

overview: Install through the Claude Code plugin marketplace (recommended): add the marketplace, then install oh-my-claudecode, entering the two commands one at a time. Or install the CLI with npm i -g oh-my-claude-sisyphus@latest.
Run /omc-setup inside Claude Code, or omc setup in a terminal. Then try /autopilot followed by a task description.

Other commands include /team for parallel agents, /ralph, /execute, /deep-interview and omc ask to query other providers. Named autopilot stage profiles currently need Linux. The project is MIT licensed.
